A workflow test fails if no kept workflow runs ruleset_drift_check.py.
context: Found in the 2026-10-09 tracker review. Note for site-split-52: ruleset_drift_check.py APPROVED_MERGE_QUEUE_CONTEXTS (lines 308-316) still lists `landing`.
description:
scripts/ruleset_drift_check.py runs only in nightly.yml (ruleset-drift job, nightly.yml:885-907), release-canary.yml (:336) and validate-release-pr.yml (:140). dlv2-70 deletes nightly.yml and dlv2-53 deletes the other two, after which nothing checks the live rulesets against the recorded ones (ADR D7). dlv2-80 and dlv2-83 assume the check still runs.

Move the check into a scheduled job that survives both retirements (for example a nightly-v2 domain) before either deletion lands.
